scripts.postinstall: (cd models/ts && npm run build) && (cd models && npm run convert)
scripts.deploy:development: python3 ops/infrastructure/minikube.py && minikube start --driver=docker && minikube kubectl -- apply -f ops/infrastructure/minikube.yaml --validate=false && minikube dashboard &>/dev/null
scripts.minikube:tunnel: minikube addons enable ingress && minikube addons enable ingress-dns && minikube tunnel
scripts.api:development: cd api && kubectl cp default/$(kubectl get pods -l app=development-c-lightning-rest -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' --all-namespaces):/usr/src/app/certs ./certs && npm run start:dev -- -- --lightning '$(minikube service development-c-lightning-rest-service --https --url)'
